CAREER OBJECTIVE 
 
To excel and be associated in the Electrical/Power/ Electronics domain in a reputed organization 
which offers challenging work environment and growth 
 
Key Expertise 
Electrical condition based Analysis—HV Rotating Machines—Diagnostic and Testing 
 
 
PROFESSIONAL SNAPSHOT 
 
 A competent engineering professional with 7 years of experience in Electronics/maintenance domain 
and 5 years experience in HV rotating machine testing field. . 
 Currently associated with Qualitrol-Iris Power as Manager-Field Services, India Operations. 
 Pursued International MBA in Operations Management from UBI, Europe and Electronics 
&Telecommunications Engineering from IETE, New Delhi. 
 Strong planning and execution skills with systematic approach. 
 Exhibits honest work ethics with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and time-sensitive environment.

Qualitrol-Iris Power, Mumbai May ’08 – till date 
Manager-Field Service (India Operations) 
 
Orchid Industries Ltd, Mumbai Oct ’05- April ’08 
Manager-Maintenance 
 
CMS Associates Pvt Ltd, Mumbai Jan ’01 – Aug ’05 
Senior Technical Engineer (Customer Support) 
 
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
 
Condition based online monitoring systems, Diagnostic and testing services for Power Generating stations, 
Captive Power Plants and Industries: 
 
 Responsible for Installation of condition based monitoring systems in HV Rotating Machines (Hydro & Turbo 
generators and Motors) 
 Adept at performing off result analysis of the products used for the monitoring purposes. 
 Undertook studying the influence of differ ent combination of parameters on the performance of the rotating 
machines through offline and online test methods. 
 Adept at rotating machines data analysis through online test system (Partial Discharge monitoring and data 
analysis for all types of HV rotating machines like turbo/Hydro generators and HV Motors ). 
 
 
TECHNICAL EXPERTISE 
 
Software EPC, Keil 
Coding skills Assembly and C++ 
Platform Windows XP & Linux
